svg.text: I’m Mohammed Minul Islam, a passionate Flutter Developer and CSE undergraduate who loves turning ideas into elegant mobile apps.
Beyond building cross-platform solutions, I challenge myself through competitive programming, which keeps my problem-solving sharp and my coding efficient.
I thrive where creativity meets logic, combining technical depth with adaptability, clear communication, and teamwork.
My goal is simple — to keep learning, building, and contributing to impactful projects that make a real difference.
